simple.meaning: properly, a whisper , i.e. by implication, (in a good sense) a private prayer , (in a bad one) an incantation ; concretely, an amulet
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to לַחַשׁ (H3908) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

definitions.short: properly, a whisper , i.e. by implication, (in a good sense) a private prayer , (in a bad one) an incantation ; concretely, an amulet
definitions.full: H3908. lachash לַ֫חַשׁ noun [masculine] a whispering, charming ; — ׳ל Isa 26:16 ; לָ֑חַשׁ Eccl 10:11 ; Isa 3:3 ; Jer 8:17 ; plural לְחָשִׁים Isa 3:20 . — 1 serpent-charming Eccl 10:11 ; לָ֑חַשׁ נְבוֺן Isa 3:3 (probably more General). 2 charms, amulets , worn by women, Isa 3:20 . 3 whisper of prayer , לַחַשׁ צָקוּן Isa 26:16 they pour forth a whisper of prayer (but Koppe Bö Gr Di Du read לַחַשׁ צְקוֺן 'Zauberzwang,' compulsion of (by) magic ).
